title: Subset Sum in Time $`O(2^{0.49n})`$
summary: We give a uniform randomized classical algorithm for Subset Sum with bounded error and worst-case running time $`O(2^{0.49n})`$ on polynomial-bit inputs in a word-RAM model, where n is the number of input integers. The time bound holds on every random execution.

review.reason: Presents a randomized algorithm for Subset Sum with running time O(2^{0.49n}).
